argv: P=606716f703f7699af458476a31fc78ddc9bf552c; W=284ab0f0b8b989ee73d9c00c0c0df0a59757af8d; H="### What stays open — named, never closed by prose"; for r in $P $W; do printf "%s lines=%s bytes=%s lastbyte=" ${r:0:8} "$(git show $r:SKILL.md | wc -l)" "$(git show $r:SKILL.md | wc -c)"; git show $r:SKILL.md | tail -c1 | od -An -c; printf "  heading_at="; git show $r:SKILL.md | grep -n -F -x "$H" | cut -d: -f1 | tr "\n" " "; echo; done; echo "== write hunks (headers only)"; git show -U0 --format= $W -- SKILL.md | grep "^@@"; echo "== write numstat"; git show --numstat --format= $W -- SKILL.md; echo "== parent is byte-prefix of write?"; n=$(git show $P:SKILL.md | wc -c); cmp <(git show $P:SKILL.md) <(git show $W:SKILL.md | head -c $n) && echo "PREFIX-EQUAL bytes=$n"; echo "== files touched by write"; git show --stat --format= $W | tail -n 3
